minor.issue: When status is skipped/failed/disabled, sent_client is not updated, so each backend restart and every 12h loop re-attempts and inserts a NEW email_log row -> duplicate 'Non riuscita'/'Non inviata' rows accumulate in the client's 'Email inviate' tab (relevant now since Resend rejects the docuanalytics.it sender: real client emails will log 'failed' repeatedly). Also logo is re-downloaded from Object Storage on every attempt.
Stored logo_type comes from client-declared MIME; a JPEG body sent as image/png passes (magic check accepts either signature) and is stored/served as image/png. Derive type from magic bytes.

integration_issues.issue: If the 'Email inviate' tab is open, a failed send (which IS logged) does not refresh the list; onSent/reload only fires on success. User must switch tab to see the new row.
